title: Identity / Brand family introduction
slide_intent: Define a common family structure because growth can make related products look disconnected.
strategic_value: A clear architecture can let Duolingo add products while supporting recognition of the master brand.
demonstration: The brand-family introduction explains the need for a shared system as languages and products expand.
practical_value: Check whether a new product identity strengthens the family before introducing a separate treatment.
